name: Memory
description: Persistent cross-session memory plus per-session short-term scratchpad. Saves via the inline <tui::memory> tag (zero-friction, mid-response); reads/edits/removes via the MemoryTool (structured CRUD by id). Three scopes: global (~/.minimal-agent/memory.md), project (~/.minimal-agent/projects/<cwd>/memory.md), short-term (~/.minimal-agent/sessions/<sid>.scratch.md). The first two are reloaded into the system prompt on every session start; short-term rides as a per-turn user-message attachment.

tool.name: MemoryTool
tool.description: List, read, add, edit, or remove saved memories. Three scopes: global (cross-project), project (this codebase), short-term (this session only). For in-flight saves mid-response, prefer the inline <tui::memory> tag — it's lower friction and the save-echo gives you the id back on the next turn. Use this tool for retrieval and curation. `id` is required for read/edit/remove; `body` for add/edit; `query` and `limit` are list-only. `clear` is only allowed for scope=short-term.

scope.description: Which memory file to act on.

id.description: Bullet id from a prior <memory-saved> echo, list result, or save-echo. Required for read/edit/remove. Persistent ids look like `lwq8tg-a8f3`; short-term ids are integers like `3`.

body.description: New body for add or edit. Single-line preferred; multi-line is collapsed to one line.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter for action=list.

limit.description: For action=list, return only the N most recent matches. Default: all.

format.description: Result format. `text` (default) returns a compact human-readable list. `json` returns a structured shape suitable when you need to extract specific values.
